TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cham.]
Taste : slimy, bitter ; sour ; like rancid fat ; putrid ; offensive at night.
Bread tastes sour.
Bitter taste in mouth, in morning.
Burning on tongue.
Tongue red in middle, white at sides. θ Tertian intermittent.
Tongue : coated, white ; yellowish ; or white at sides, red in middle ; red, cracked ; dry.
Severe biting on back of tongue and on roof of palate.
Tongue dry, with thirst for water, loss of appetite, flushes of heat, sweat of face and palpitation, followed by unnatural hunger.
Blisters on and beneath tongue, with stinging pain.
Convulsive movements of tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cham.]
Heat in mouth, pharynx and œsophagus to stomach.
Dryness of mouth, in morning, followed by distension of abdomen and imperfect evacuation.
Extreme dryness in mouth, with lameness of limbs.
Collection of saliva, of metallic, sweetish taste.
Offensive taste in mouth, at night.
What he hawks up has an offensive taste.
Sourish odor from mouth.
Fetid smell from mouth.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cham.]
Pain in left side of fauces while swallowing ; velum was somewhat reddened, and external pressure just under angle of jaw caused pain in fauces.
Spasmodic drawing pain in palate, extending into fauces.
Pain in back part of throat, < by moving throat and swallowing.
Spasmodic constriction of pharynx.
Stitches in throat, near ear.
Throbbing in back part of throat.
Inflammation of throat, with sensation as though something was sticking in it, which ought to be removed by hawking ; heat in pharynx, and thirst ; dark redness of affected parts.
Catarrhal inflammation of throat, of tonsils or pharynx, with acute stinging-burning pain in larynx ; usually roughness of voice, some dyspnœa, tickling irritation to cough.
Sore throat, with swelling of parotid or submaxillary glands, or tonsils.
Difficult swallowing of solid food, and when lying down.
Sore throat from suppression of cutaneous action.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cham.]
Unnatural hunger, in evening.
Want of appetite.
When food is set before him, it makes him shudder, it is so repugnant.
Great thirst for cold water and desire for acid drinks.
Thirst, with febrile heat and redness of cheeks.
Unquenchable thirst, with dryness of tongue.
Increased thirst, with evening fever and painful diarrhœa.
Likes to hold cold water to mouth a long time, when drinking. θ Dentition.
Desire for : acids ; sauerkraut.
Aversion to : beer ; coffee and warm drinks ; to broth.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Cham.]
Fulness while eating, with nausea after eating.
After eating and drinking, heat and sweat of face.
After eating : vertigo ; abdomen puffed up.
Thirsty and hot with the pains.
In morning, after drinking coffee, heat all over and sweat, with vomiting of bitter mucus, followed by bitter taste in mouth, weakness in head, and nausea.
After drinking coffee : vertigo.
Cutting pain and debility after drinking.
